attr.title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories
attr.desc: AArch64 PortMaster compatibility port of the Android release of Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories. Rockstar game files are not included.
attr.inst: Requires a complete, legally owned LCS 2.4.379 ARM64 Google Play installation. Copy base.apk, the matching arm64-v8a split and data_main asset split (or a complete APKS/APKM/XAPK bundle) into ports/gtalcs/gamedata, then launch once. This release uses Play Asset Delivery, not an OBB.
